comment: Models Atlas recommends per role and runtime (phase2-spec §7.1, ADR 0012). Bundled with each release and read offline; Atlas never downloads a model. `match` lists model-id fragments (compared with every non-alphanumeric character removed, ignoring case) that identify an installed copy. `verified` means the runtime is known to serve this model: listed in its own catalog or checked with Atlas's capability test; otherwise the card says it hasn't been checked. Sizes are the runtime's download, rounded. `weakMargin`: how far above `minSimilarity` the best meaning match must be for Ask Atlas not to say it found little (0.2, tuned for Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B with the off-library questions, Slice 2.6.3; the 4B inherits it unmeasured).

models.queryPrefix:
Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve passages that answer it
Query:
models.label: Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B
models.why: Small and fast, good in many languages, and the model Atlas's search quality is measured with.

steps: Open oMLX's admin page (http://localhost:8000/admin).
In Model Downloader, search for Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and download the MLX build mlx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-8bit.
Back in Atlas, choose Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-8bit for Embeddings and press Test.
Run the command in Terminal (or Command Prompt).
Back in Atlas, choose qwen3-embedding:0.6b for Embeddings and press Test.
In LM Studio, open Discover and search for Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B.
Download a GGUF build and load it as a text-embedding model.
Back in Atlas, choose the id LM Studio shows for it and press Test.

models.queryPrefix:
Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve passages that answer it
Query:
models.label: Qwen3-Embedding 4B
models.why: Finds more by meaning than the 0.6B model, but indexing takes several times longer and the index is about two and a half times larger.

steps: Open oMLX's admin page (http://localhost:8000/admin).
In Model Downloader, search for Qwen3-Embedding-4B and download an MLX build.
Back in Atlas, choose it for Embeddings and press Test.
Run the command in Terminal (or Command Prompt).
Back in Atlas, choose qwen3-embedding:4b for Embeddings and press Test.
In LM Studio, open Discover and search for Qwen3 Embedding 4B.
Download a GGUF build and load it as a text-embedding model.
Back in Atlas, choose the id LM Studio shows for it and press Test.

models.label: Qwen3.5 9B
models.why: Answers questions about your library well on a 16 GB computer, and quickly.

steps: Open oMLX's admin page (http://localhost:8000/admin).
In Model Downloader, search for Qwen3.5-9B and download a 4-bit MLX build.
Back in Atlas, choose it for Chat and press Test.
Run the command in Terminal (or Command Prompt).
Back in Atlas, choose qwen3.5:9b for Chat and press Test.
In LM Studio, open Discover and search for Qwen3.5 9B.
Download it and load it.
Back in Atlas, choose the id LM Studio shows for it and press Test.
